result.name: goodwin
result.title: Goodwin oscillator (external PMR CellML, non-stiff, multimodal)
result.description: Gradient-free global searches (genetic algorithm, CMA-ES) vs multi-start L-BFGS-B (finite differences and Myokit CVODES FSA) recovering rate constants of the Goodwin 1965 oscillator, taken directly from the Physiome Model Repository as external CellML. Oscillatory dynamics make the least-squares surface multimodal.
result.env_note: 8 MPI rank(s); 30000 cost evaluations for the population methods; 16 starts for multi-start
